Interior Renovation · Calgary, AB

Carpet Removal & 5" Oak Hardwood Install

Phase 1 of a multi-room renovation. We removed the old carpet and underlay, prepped the subfloor, then installed 5" solid oak hardwood through the hallway and bedroom, hand-stained in a rich dark finish and sealed to a high gloss. Every board staggered for a natural, seamless look. Phase 2, including stair nosing and trim, is planned for next year.

  • Demo
    Carpet, underlay & tack strip removed
  • Prep
    Subfloor cleaned, fastened & levelled
  • Install
    5" solid oak, staggered layout
  • Finish
    Dark stain, sealed to a glossy shine
